title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Benefits — Advance Late Fee Relief
content:
The plan of the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account bears on the payroll-delay relief of a late fee on the linked Pocketwire Advance line. When the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Summit, 0.10 is added to the relief share; when it is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Prime, 0.05 is added to the relief share; any other plan adds nothing to the relief share. The relief share is the fraction of the late fee that the relief returns. The plan is the one the personal account's record shows.

| Personal account plan | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Summit | 0.10 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 0.05 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 0.05 |
| Pocketwire Plus | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Core | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Lite | Nothing |

Illustration (hypothetical): a customer on Pocketwire Onyx adds 0.05 to the relief share; a customer on Pocketwire Plus adds nothing.
